subject: Doing Data Science with R: One Page Recipes for R

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Doing Data Science with R: One Page Recipes for R
parts:
For those who have moved into R or wanting to get more familiar with R I am getting together a collection of OnePageR's for various tasks covered in the Rattle book and beyond, but focussed just on R. 

Some preliminary documents are available at http://onepager.togaware.com. Many more are in draft and will appear soon.

Comments, feedback, suggestions, and contributions are most welcome.

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Doing Data Science with R: One Page Recipes for R
parts:
Hi Tom,

Did you

> source("http://onepager.togaware.com/experi.R")

I run http://onepager.togaware.com/Models.pdf live from this same file so the source has to be okay (given that the PDF no longer has the errors you pointed out). Are you sure you are getting the latest version? Watch out for web browser caches.

You can check you have the current version:

> source("http://onepager.togaware.com/experi.R")
> str(experi)
function (form, ds, target, modeller, details = "", n = 100, control = NULL, 
    keep = FALSE, prob = "prob", class = "class")  
[...]

You should see "keep = FALSE" in the correct version rather than "keep.pr = FALSE" of the old version.


Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
